fib: ______ is a crude attempt to approximate LRU.
NFU
NFU is a crude attempt to approximate LRU.
______ is called compaction (or recompaction, since it is done many times).
process
The process is called compaction (or recompaction, since it is done many times).

______ is a request made by any program to the kernel for performing tasks, picked from a predefined set, which the said program does not have the required permissions to execute in its own flow of execution.
system call

A system call is a request made by any program to the kernel for performing tasks, picked from a predefined set, which the said program does not have the required permissions to execute in its own flow of execution.
______ is A, which arrived at time 0, when the process started.
oldest page
The oldest page is A, which arrived at time 0, when the process started.
______ is a subdirectory with four subdirectories: prog, copy, prt and exp.
Mail
Mail is a subdirectory with four subdirectories: prog, copy, prt and exp.
______ refers to pages that have not been modified since it was read into memory.
Clean pages
Clean pages - refers to pages that have not been modified since it was read into memory.
______ is an excellent algorithm, but it cannot be implemented without special hardware.
LRU
LRU is an excellent algorithm, but it cannot be implemented without special hardware.
______ refers to the ability of multiple processes ( or threads) to share code, resources, or data in such a way that only one process has access to the shared object at a time.
Mutual exclusion
Mutual exclusion refers to the ability of multiple processes ( or threads) to share code, resources, or data in such a way that only one process has access to the shared object at a time.
______ is a single integer variable which can take non negative value and upon which two operations, called wait and signal, are defined.
semaphore
A semaphore is a single integer variable which can take non negative value and upon which two operations, called wait and signal, are defined.
______ is a difficult phenomenon to anticipate, and there are no easy general solutions to this problem.
Deadlock
Deadlock is a difficult phenomenon to anticipate, and there are no easy general solutions to this problem.
______ is a kind of stripped down process, it is just one 'active hand' in a program, something which the CPU is doing on behalf of a program, but not enough to be called a complete process.
thread
A thread is a kind of stripped down process, it is just one 'active hand' in a program, something which the CPU is doing on behalf of a program, but not enough to be called a complete process.

______ is a degenerate case that occurs when there is insufficient memory at one level in the memory hierarchy to properly contain the working set required by the upper levels of the memory hierarchy.
Thrashing

Thrashing is a degenerate case that occurs when there is insufficient memory at one level in the memory hierarchy to properly contain the working set required by the upper levels of the memory hierarchy.
______ is the software that controls the allocation and usage of hardware resources such as memory, CPU time, disk space, and input and output devices.
operating system
The operating system is the software that controls the allocation and usage of hardware resources such as memory, CPU time, disk space, and input and output devices.

Print (live) debugging
Print debugging

segment
